title: Mailbox/query rejects sort rather than silently ignoring — correct per spec
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_query:135-139 returns JmapError::unsupported_sort() for any non-empty sort array. RFC 8620 §5.5 requires unsupportedSort rather than silent ignore. A contributor might 'simplify' this to just ignore the sort. Defend: silent ignore is spec non-conformance and produces confusing results when sort is expected (returns wrong order without error). The current behavior is correct.
